text:
nora: quick heads-up from onboarding smoke: py-sdk JSON-mode sanitizer is filling in defaults for missing array props (schema has default: []) which made sample-app show an empty list where we expected null/missing. caused weird UX in the quickstart.

ash: can you paste the schema + example model output?

nora: simplified schema:```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "matches": {
      "type": ["array", "null"],
      "items": { "type": "string" },
      "default": []
    }
  }
}
```
raw model output we saw in the fncall: `{"matches": null}`

felix: why is sanitizer turning null into []? default should only apply when key missing, not when explicitly null.

nora: exactly. sanitizer's `applyDefaults()` step was unconditional: if schema has default, set missing-or-null to default. bug. should treat null as explicit value. causing onboarding sample to think user had empty matches when model intentionally returned null meaning "no data".

ash: oh man. this also interacts badly with our auth/retry flow: if server returns a 401 with a short body and we retry, the sanitizer may run on the intermediate partial and apply defaults, then merge with retry result in an inconsistent way. we saw an example where first attempt body `{"matches":` was truncated and sanitizer applied default -> [] before retry restored null, leaving an empty array in logs.

marco: yeah we had a class of flakiness reported in support tickets where onboarding sample showed empty lists unexpectedly. suspect same root.

felix: proposed fix: change applyDefaults to only apply when the property is truly missing (not present with value null). For union types including null, treat null as a valid literal and don't replace with default. Also ensure sanitizer runs only after we have the final successful response (move sanitizer call after retry logic in the client request flow).

nora: opened PR: https://git.redwood/s/sdk-py/default-null-respect (WIP). added unit tests: 1) missing property -> default applied, 2) property present null -> null preserved, 3) union[array,null] with explicit null -> null preserved. Also added integration test simulating 401+retry to ensure sanitizer sees final body.

ci-bot: CI queued for PR default-null-respect  build 12188. sample-app onboarding suite included.

ash: small follow-up: add a telemetry gauge for how often default would have been applied to explicit nulls prior to this fix so we can estimate user impact. and add a changelog note since behavior around defaults changed.

marco: also audit other sdks for same defect (js, go, dotnet). file DEVEX-3680 to track parity.

felix: quick note on release strategy: patch py-sdk 1.x and also backport to 0.x used in some starter templates. include migration note: "defaults now only apply when field is missing; explicit nulls preserved".

nora: CI green, merged, released py-sdk v1.4.2 and backport to 0.9.8. starter templates updated. tagging support to close related tickets.

ash: nice catch. should reduce a lot of "where did my data go" onboarding confusion. :rocket:
